pages.title: Cropped Shirt – Corso Velle
descriptions: A modern take on the classic shirt, designed with a relaxed, boxy silhouette and a slightly cropped length that sits neatly around the waist. Easy to style and comfortable for everyday wear.

pages.title: Designer Shacket – Corso Velle
descriptions: Designed with detailed embroidery and a relaxed, cropped silhouette, this shirt adds character without feeling overdone. Easy to wear on its own or layered for a more styled look.

pages.title: Embroidered Shirt – Corso Velle
descriptions: Made from a soft viscose-cotton blend, this Cuban shirt features detailed floral embroidery and a relaxed open collar. Its boxy, semi-cropped fit makes it comfortable, easy to style and perfect for everyday wear.

pages.title: Gurkha Flared Trouser – Corso Velle
descriptions: A modern take on classic Gurkha tailoring, these trousers feature an adjustable high-rise waistband, sharp double pleats and a subtle flared leg. Clean and structured, they work effortlessly for both smart and casual styling.

pages.title: Jeans – Corso Velle
descriptions: Made from durable 13 oz denim, these jeans feature a structured feel and relaxed baggy fit that falls wide through the leg. Finished with a washed effect for an easy, everyday streetwear look.

pages.title: Knit Polo – Corso Velle
descriptions: A refined take on the classic polo, featuring a textured knit finish, clean stripes and a relaxed fit. Finished with a structured collar and neat placket for an easy smart-casual look.

pages.title: Linen Pants – Corso Velle
descriptions: Made from lightweight, breathable linen, these pants feature a relaxed straight-leg fit and a clean, easy finish. Comfortable for warm days and simple to style for both casual and refined looks.

pages.title: Linen Shirt – Corso Velle
descriptions: Made from lightweight, breathable linen, these shirts feature a relaxed fit, band collar and clean chest-pocket detailing. Easy to dress up or down for warm, everyday wear.
